privacy_sections.p: Anonymous visit counter: each page view increments a daily counter, with no identifier or IP address stored. Anonymous click counter: clicks to external platforms (Payhip, Gumroad, Shopify, Google Play) are counted in aggregate. There is no user account on this site.

Language cookie: remembers your language choice (French, English, Haitian Creole, Spanish). Technical session cookie: used only for the admin area. Local storage: remembers your visual theme choice, only on your device.
Counters are used solely to measure site traffic, internally. No profiling, no targeted advertising.
No data is sold or shared with third parties.
Buttons to purchase or download platforms (Payhip, Gumroad, Shopify, Google Play) redirect you to third-party sites, subject to their own privacy policies.
For any question about this policy, contact Lesly Tech LLC through the channels listed on this site.
